generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's decurrent tree species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 1926), family 62 Fagaceae: trees; leaves alternate, simple, pinnately veined; stipules present, often soon falling; flowers unisexual on the same tree, the male in erect or catkin-like spikes; calyx 4- to 6-lobed, no petals; ovary inferior, 3- to 6-celled; fruit a nut in a cup or husk (involucre). Hutchinson's Fagaceae held Nothofagus, now its own family.
